jp: 近年質の低下し続けている傭兵の中では珍しく腕利きの傭兵であり、かなりの経験を積んでいる。だが乗り物にすごく弱い。そのため長距離移動のない仕事をメインにしている。
jp_grezzo: "近年質の低下し続けている傭兵の中では珍しく腕利きの傭兵であり、かなりの経験を積んでいる。だが乗り物にすごく弱い。そのため長距離移動のない仕事をメインにしている。"
en: He is an unusually skilled mercenary and has considerable experience among mercenaries, whose quality has continued to decline in recent years. However, he has motion sickness. For this reason, he mainly works in jobs that do not involve long-distance travel.
en_grezzo: "He is an unusually skilled mercenary and has considerable experience among mercenaries, whose quality has continued to decline in recent years. However, he has motion sickness. For this reason, he mainly works in jobs that do not involve long-distance travel."
it: Fra i mercenari, la cui qualità continua a calare di anno in anno, è uno dei rari che sappiano davvero il mestiere, e di esperienza ne ha accumulata parecchia. Solo che i mezzi di trasporto gli fanno malissimo, e per questo prende soprattutto lavori senza lunghi spostamenti.

jp: 硝煙やメカの駆動音、機械油の匂いなどが好きで、将軍でありながら趣味はメカの設計。時折、無茶苦茶な装備を考案してはガベラと盛り上がっている。
jp_grezzo: "硝煙やメカの駆動音、機械油の匂いなどが好きで、将軍でありながら趣味はメカの設計。時折、無茶苦茶な装備を考案してはガベラと盛り上がっている。"
en: He likes the smell of gunpowder, the sound of mechanical drives and machine oil, and despite being a general, his hobby is designing mechanisms. From time to time, he devises absurd equipment and gets excited with Gavela.
en_grezzo: "He likes the smell of gunpowder, the sound of mechanical drives and machine oil, and despite being a general, his hobby is designing mechanisms. From time to time, he devises absurd equipment and gets excited with Gavela. "
it: Gli piacciono l'odore della polvere da sparo, il rumore dei motori e il profumo dell'olio da macchine, e benché sia un generale il suo passatempo è progettare congegni. Ogni tanto inventa equipaggiamenti assurdi e si esalta insieme a Gavela.

jp: ヒットマンな妹。殺しの標的の身近に潜伏し、チェーンソーの音を毎日鳴らして散々恐怖を味わわせた後に仕留めるのが快感。強烈な性格で、痛い日記を書いている。
jp_grezzo: "ヒットマンな妹。殺しの標的の身近に潜伏し、チェーンソーの音を毎日鳴らして散々恐怖を味わわせた後に仕留めるのが快感。強烈な性格で、痛い日記を書いている。"
en: Hitman younger sister. She enjoys hiding in the vicinity of her kill targets and killing them after terrorising them extensively with the daily sound of her chainsaw. She has a strong personality and keeps a very cringy diary.
en_grezzo: "Hitman younger sister. She enjoys hiding in the vicinity of her kill targets and killing them after terrorising them extensively with the daily sound of her chainsaw. She has a strong personality and keeps a very cringy diary."
it: Una sorella minore che fa la sicaria. Si apposta vicino al bersaglio, ogni giorno gli fa sentire il rumore della motosega e, dopo averlo fatto morire di paura, se lo prende: è quello il suo piacere. Ha un carattere fortissimo e tiene un diario da far accapponare la pelle.

jp: ルードゥスに住んでいる、あなたと血の繋がっていない姉。たまにしか顔を出さないあなたに対して不満を感じつつも、いつでもあなたの帰りを待ってくれている。
jp_grezzo: "ルードゥスに住んでいる、あなたと血の繋がっていない姉。たまにしか顔を出さないあなたに対して不満を感じつつも、いつでもあなたの帰りを待ってくれている。"
en: Your older sister, who lives in Ludus and is not blood-related to you. She is always waiting for you to come home, although she is dissatisfied with your occasional visits.
en_grezzo: "Your older sister, who lives in Ludus and is not blood-related to you. She is always waiting for you to come home, although she is dissatisfied with your occasional visits. "
it: La tua sorella maggiore, che vive a Ludus e non ha il tuo sangue. Le dispiace che tu ti faccia vedere solo ogni tanto, eppure il tuo ritorno lo aspetta sempre.

jp: 人懐っこい犬科の血の繋がらない義理の姉。弟（妹）に仇なす者には精一杯威嚇するものの、あまり迫力がない。メイド服は趣味。
jp_grezzo: "人懐っこい犬科の血の繋がらない義理の姉。弟（妹）に仇なす者には精一杯威嚇するものの、あまり迫力がない。メイド服は趣味。"
en: Non-blood-related older sister-in-law of a human-friendly canine family. She is not very strong, although she is as intimidating as possible towards those who would avenge her brother (or sister). Maid's clothes are a hobby.
en_grezzo: "Non-blood-related older sister-in-law of a human-friendly canine family. She is not very strong, although she is as intimidating as possible towards those who would avenge her brother (or sister). Maid's clothes are a hobby."
it: Una sorella acquisita, di stirpe canina e affettuosa, che non ha il tuo sangue. Con chi vuole fare del male al fratello (o alla sorella) minore ringhia con tutta sé stessa, ma non fa una gran paura. Il vestito da cameriera è un suo gusto.

jp: 暴風神ルドラの力を受け継ぐ息子たち。風のルルウィとの覇権争いの際、肉体を滅ぼされ竜巻そのものに変えられてしまった。それ以来彼女に忠誠を誓わされている。
jp_grezzo: "暴風神ルドラの力を受け継ぐ息子たち。風のルルウィとの覇権争いの際、肉体を滅ぼされ竜巻そのものに変えられてしまった。それ以来彼女に忠誠を誓わされている。"
en: Sons of Rudra, the storm god, who inherited his power. During a struggle for supremacy with Lulwy of the Wind, their bodies were destroyed and turned into tornadoes themselves. Since then, they have been sworn to her allegiance.
en_grezzo: "Sons of Rudra, the storm god, who inherited his power. During a struggle for supremacy with Lulwy of the Wind, their bodies were destroyed and turned into tornadoes themselves. Since then, they have been sworn to her allegiance."
it: I figli che hanno ereditato la forza di Rudra, il dio della tempesta. Nella lotta per il primato con Lulwy del vento il loro corpo fu distrutto e furono trasformati in trombe d'aria. Da allora sono costretti a giurarle fedeltà.

jp: あなたと血の繋がっていない姉。それでもあなたが大好きで、甘えてきて欲しいと常に考えている。姉にとってあなたは、何時までたっても弟（妹）なのだ。
jp_grezzo: "あなたと血の繋がっていない姉。それでもあなたが大好きで、甘えてきて欲しいと常に考えている。姉にとってあなたは、何時までたっても弟（妹）なのだ。"
en: Your older sister who is not related to you by blood. She still loves you and always wants you to spoil her. To her, you will always be her little brother (sister).
en_grezzo: "Your older sister who is not related to you by blood. She still loves you and always wants you to spoil her. To her, you will always be her little brother (sister)."
it: La tua sorella maggiore, che non ha il tuo sangue. Eppure ti vuole un bene dell'anima e non aspetta altro che tu le faccia qualche coccola. Per lei tu resterai per sempre il fratello (o la sorella) minore.

jp: 本来存在しないはずの生命体。発生原因は様々。
jp_grezzo: "本来存在しないはずの生命体。発生原因は様々。"
en: A being that shouldn't exist. Its origin varies.
en_grezzo: "A being that shouldn't exist. Its origin varies."
it: Una forma di vita che non dovrebbe esistere. Le cause per cui compare sono le più varie.

jp: Unique-subconscious-extra-reactunt（特有潜在意識による範囲外反応体）の略称。特有の人間の潜在意識がこの世界の外の物と反応して、こちら側にその存在を定着させてしまった。
jp_grezzo: "Unique-subconscious-extra-reactunt（特有潜在意識による範囲外反応体）の略称。特有の人間の潜在意識がこの世界の外の物と反応して、こちら側にその存在を定着させてしまった。"
en: Abbreviation for unique-subconscious-extra-reactant. The unique human subconscious has reacted with things outside this world and established its presence on this side of the world.
en_grezzo: "Abbreviation for unique-subconscious-extra-reactant. The unique human subconscious has reacted with things outside this world and established its presence on this side of the world. "
it: Sigla di Unique-subconscious-extra-reactant, il corpo che reagisce fuori campo per via di un subconscio particolare. Il subconscio particolare di un essere umano ha reagito con qualcosa che sta fuori da questo mondo, e ne ha fissato la presenza al di qua.

jp: 様々な物資を販売している町の顔。強盗対策のため、銃器の扱いに長けている。ほとんど交渉の才能がないので、店を継ぐ際には猛特訓するらしい。
jp_grezzo: "様々な物資を販売している町の顔。強盗対策のため、銃器の扱いに長けている。ほとんど交渉の才能がないので、店を継ぐ際には猛特訓するらしい。"
en: A person who sells various goods and serves as the public face of the town. Adept at using firearms to prevent robbery. Since they have next to no ability to negotiate, a rigorous training period is required when they inherit a store.
en_grezzo: "A person who sells various goods and serves as the public face of the town. Adept at using firearms to prevent robbery. Since they have next to no ability to negotiate, a rigorous training period is required when they inherit a store."
it: Il volto della città, che vende ogni sorta di merce. Contro le rapine è bravissimo a maneggiare le armi da fuoco. Di talento per la trattativa non ne ha quasi per niente, e pare che quando eredita la bottega gli tocchi un addestramento durissimo.

jp: 交易商たちが集団的に身を守るために組織したキャラバンの指揮を任されている。国の信頼も厚く、関所を簡単なチェックだけで通行できる。
jp_grezzo: "交易商たちが集団的に身を守るために組織したキャラバンの指揮を任されている。国の信頼も厚く、関所を簡単なチェックだけで通行できる。"
en: They are entrusted with leading caravans organised by traders for collective security. They are well trusted by the state and can pass through customs with only a simple check.
en_grezzo: "They are entrusted with leading caravans organised by traders for collective security. They are well trusted by the state and can pass through customs with only a simple check. "
it: Gli è affidato il comando delle carovane che i mercanti organizzano per difendersi tutti insieme. Gode di grande fiducia presso lo stato, e ai posti di blocco passa con un controllo sbrigativo.

jp: 酔っぱらって死んだ客からも代金を回収するために、蘇生法を会得している。近年では蘇生サービスやペット預かりといった副業の方が人気になってしまい困惑気味。飲み物を注文されると内心とても嬉しい。
jp_grezzo: "酔っぱらって死んだ客からも代金を回収するために、蘇生法を会得している。近年では蘇生サービスやペット預かりといった副業の方が人気になってしまい困惑気味。飲み物を注文されると内心とても嬉しい。"
en: One has mastered resurrection in order to collect money from drunken and dead customers as well. In recent years, they has been baffled by the growing popularity of side jobs such as resurrection services and pet care. They are secretly very happy when people order drinks from them.
en_grezzo: "One has mastered resurrection in order to collect money from drunken and dead customers as well. In recent years, they has been baffled by the growing popularity of side jobs such as resurrection services and pet care. They are secretly very happy when people order drinks from them."
it: Per riscuotere il conto anche dai clienti che muoiono ubriachi ha imparato l'arte di risuscitare. In questi anni i mestieri secondari, come il servizio di resurrezione e la custodia degli animali, sono diventati più richiesti del suo, e la cosa lo lascia un po' perplesso. Quando gli ordinano da bere, dentro di sé è contentissimo.

jp: 持っている情報をひけらかすのを生きがいとする。依頼とあらば、ターゲットの体重まで一瞬で調べ上げるプロ。職業柄、国家機密に目が眩んで抹殺されることも。
jp_grezzo: "持っている情報をひけらかすのを生きがいとする。依頼とあらば、ターゲットの体重まで一瞬で調べ上げるプロ。職業柄、国家機密に目が眩んで抹殺されることも。"
en: They live to reveal the information they have. When requested to do so, this professional can even find out the weight of a target in an instant. In their profession, they are sometimes blinded by national secrets and eliminated.
en_grezzo: "They live to reveal the information they have. When requested to do so, this professional can even find out the weight of a target in an instant. In their profession, they are sometimes blinded by national secrets and eliminated."
it: Vive per sfoggiare le informazioni che possiede. Se glielo si chiede, questo professionista scopre in un istante perfino quanto pesa il bersaglio. È un mestiere in cui a volte, accecati da un segreto di stato, si finisce tolti di mezzo.

jp: 血なまぐさい戦いを観る趣味が行き過ぎて闘技場を作ってしまった。アリーナのために生活費をつぎ込むのが原因で、家族から再三やめるように言われている。
jp_grezzo: "血なまぐさい戦いを観る趣味が行き過ぎて闘技場を作ってしまった。アリーナのために生活費をつぎ込むのが原因で、家族から再三やめるように言われている。"
en: Their hobby of watching bloody fights has gone too far and they have built an arena. Because of the money they spend on living expenses for the arena, they are repeatedly told by their families to stop.
en_grezzo: "Their hobby of watching bloody fights has gone too far and they have built an arena. Because of the money they spend on living expenses for the arena, they are repeatedly told by their families to stop. "
it: Il gusto di guardare i combattimenti sanguinosi gli ha preso talmente la mano che si è costruito un anfiteatro. Siccome nell'arena butta i soldi che servono per vivere, la famiglia gli ripete da anni di smetterla.

jp: 心身の衰弱や、かけられた呪いを払う術を身に付けている。彼女達に癒される為にわざわざ大変な目に遭ってくる者達も居る。
jp_grezzo: "心身の衰弱や、かけられた呪いを払う術を身に付けている。彼女達に癒される為にわざわざ大変な目に遭ってくる者達も居る。"
en: They have mastered the art of dispelling mental and physical ailments and curses that have been placed on them. Because of their popularity, some people go to great lengths to be healed by them.
en_grezzo: "They have mastered the art of dispelling mental and physical ailments and curses that have been placed on them. Because of their popularity, some people go to great lengths to be healed by them. "
it: Ha imparato l'arte di scacciare lo sfinimento del corpo e dello spirito, e le maledizioni che ci si trova addosso. C'è perfino chi si mette apposta nei guai peggiori pur di farsi curare da loro.

jp: 神に仕える修道女。あらゆる人々の懺悔を分け隔てなく聞いてくれるが、怒ると素が出る。また、誠意を見せない者には容赦しない。
jp_grezzo: "神に仕える修道女。あらゆる人々の懺悔を分け隔てなく聞いてくれるが、怒ると素が出る。また、誠意を見せない者には容赦しない。"
en: A nun in the service of God. She listens to all kinds of people's confessions without distinction, but when she is angry, her true nature comes out. She also shows no mercy to those who do not show sincerity.
en_grezzo: "A nun in the service of God. She listens to all kinds of people's confessions without distinction, but when she is angry, her true nature comes out. She also shows no mercy to those who do not show sincerity."
it: Una monaca consacrata alla divinità. Ascolta senza distinzioni le confessioni di chiunque, ma quando si arrabbia le esce fuori com'è fatta davvero. E con chi non le mostra sincerità non usa nessuna pietà.

jp: 長を決めることになった際に誰も立候補者がいなかったため、くじ引きで決められた。長としての仕事は放置気味だが、みんな面倒くさがって文句すら言わない。
jp_grezzo: "長を決めることになった際に誰も立候補者がいなかったため、くじ引きで決められた。長としての仕事は放置気味だが、みんな面倒くさがって文句すら言わない。"
en: When it was decided to choose a leader, no one stood for the job, so it was decided by lot. The work as head is neglected, but everyone is too lazy to even complain about it.
en_grezzo: "When it was decided to choose a leader, no one stood for the job, so it was decided by lot. The work as head is neglected, but everyone is too lazy to even complain about it. "
it: Quando si dovette scegliere il capo non si candidò nessuno, e allora lo tirarono a sorte. Il lavoro di capo lo trascura volentieri, ma sono tutti troppo pigri anche solo per lamentarsi.

jp: 自分ではできないことでも他人に教えることが出来る、すごい才能の持ち主。稼ぎをピンハネされるのを嫌い、ギルドには所属していない。
jp_grezzo: "自分ではできないことでも他人に教えることが出来る、すごい才能の持ち主。稼ぎをピンハネされるのを嫌い、ギルドには所属していない。"
en: Has an amazing talent for teaching others things they can't do themselves. He does not belong to a guild because he hates being pinned on his earnings.
en_grezzo: "Has an amazing talent for teaching others things they can't do themselves. He does not belong to a guild because he hates being pinned on his earnings. "
it: Ha il talento straordinario di insegnare agli altri perfino quello che lui non sa fare. Non gli va che gli sfilino una fetta del guadagno, e per questo alla gilda non appartiene.

jp: ギルド所属のトレイナー。人見知りが激しいのでギルドの外には滅多に出ない。稼いだプラチナの半分はギルドのために使われる。
jp_grezzo: "ギルド所属のトレイナー。人見知りが激しいのでギルドの外には滅多に出ない。稼いだプラチナの半分はギルドのために使われる。"
en: Trainer affiliated with the guild. They are very shy and seldom go outside the guild. Half of the platinum he earns goes to the guild.
en_grezzo: "Trainer affiliated with the guild. They are very shy and seldom go outside the guild. Half of the platinum he earns goes to the guild."
it: Un istruttore che appartiene alla gilda. È di una timidezza fortissima e fuori dalla gilda non mette quasi mai piede. Metà del platino che guadagna finisce alla gilda.

jp: 一説では市民の平和を守っているらしい。自分の身に危害が及ぶと全力で自身の身を守りだす習性がある。死ぬと厳しい再訓練が待っている。
jp_grezzo: "一説では市民の平和を守っているらしい。自分の身に危害が及ぶと全力で自身の身を守りだす習性がある。死ぬと厳しい再訓練が待っている。"
en: According to one theory, they ought to protect the peaceful lives of the civilians. They have a habit of defending themselves at all costs when harm comes to them. If they die, they must undergo rigorous re-training.
en_grezzo: "According to one theory, they ought to protect the peaceful lives of the civilians. They have a habit of defending themselves at all costs when harm comes to them. If they die, they must undergo rigorous re-training."
it: Stando a una certa teoria proteggerebbe la vita tranquilla dei cittadini. Ha l'abitudine, appena il pericolo tocca lei, di difendere sé stessa con tutte le forze. Se muore, l'aspetta un riaddestramento durissimo.

jp: 一説では市民の平和を守っているらしい。自分の身に危害が及ぶと全力で自身の身を守りだす習性がある。監視者でもあり、市民の居場所を完全に把握している。
jp_grezzo: "一説では市民の平和を守っているらしい。自分の身に危害が及ぶと全力で自身の身を守りだす習性がある。監視者でもあり、市民の居場所を完全に把握している。"
en: According to one theory, they ought to protect the peaceful lives of the civilians. They have a habit of defending themselves at all costs when harm comes to them. He is also a observer and has full knowledge of the whereabouts of the citizens.
en_grezzo: "According to one theory, they ought to protect the peaceful lives of the civilians. They have a habit of defending themselves at all costs when harm comes to them. He is also a observer and has full knowledge of the whereabouts of the citizens."
it: Stando a una certa teoria proteggerebbe la vita tranquilla dei cittadini. Ha l'abitudine, appena il pericolo tocca lei, di difendere sé stessa con tutte le forze. È anche una sorvegliante, e sa in ogni momento dove si trovi ciascun cittadino.

jp: 偉い人が避難する時間を稼ぐために駆り出される特殊な部隊。その散り様は戦場を彩るスパイスである。本人たちは至って本気なのがまた哀しい。
jp_grezzo: "偉い人が避難する時間を稼ぐために駆り出される特殊な部隊。その散り様は戦場を彩るスパイスである。本人たちは至って本気なのがまた哀しい。"
en: Special forces are sent out to buy time for the authorities to evacuate. Their dispersal is the spice of the battlefield. It is also sad that they are so serious about their job.
en_grezzo: "Special forces are sent out to buy time for the authorities to evacuate. Their dispersal is the spice of the battlefield. It is also sad that they are so serious about their job."
it: Un reparto speciale che mandano allo sbaraglio per far guadagnare tempo ai pezzi grossi in fuga. Il modo in cui cadono è la spezia che dà colore al campo di battaglia. E la cosa più triste è che loro ci credono sul serio.

jp: 知識欲に駆られ地位も自由も捨てた魔術士。例えレシマスの下層ごと封印されなかったとしても、彼は自ら地下に留まり《常闇の眼》を眺め続けていたことだろう。
jp_grezzo: "知識欲に駆られ地位も自由も捨てた魔術士。例えレシマスの下層ごと封印されなかったとしても、彼は自ら地下に留まり《常闇の眼》を眺め続けていたことだろう。"
en: A mage who forsake both status and freedom to pursue his thirst for knowledge. Even had he not been sealed within the depths of Lesimas, he would have remained there to continue viewing the Origin of Vice.
en_grezzo: "A mage who forsake both status and freedom to pursue his thirst for knowledge. Even had he not been sealed within the depths of Lesimas, he would have remained there to continue viewing the Origin of Vice."
it: Un mago che, spinto dalla fame di sapere, ha buttato via posizione e libertà. Anche se non fosse stato sigillato insieme ai piani bassi di Lesimas, sarebbe rimasto laggiù di sua volontà a contemplare l'<occhio delle tenebre eterne>.

jp: ある者は力の限界を悟り、またある者は来世の自分の活躍を願いその言葉を発した。それはいつしか力を得、世界の隙間を這いずり廻る。その名を呼ばれるその時まで。
jp_grezzo: "ある者は力の限界を悟り、またある者は来世の自分の活躍を願いその言葉を発した。それはいつしか力を得、世界の隙間を這いずり廻る。その名を呼ばれるその時まで。"
en: Certain people realised the limits of their power, while others uttered the words in the hope that they would be active in the next life. Somehow it gained power and crawled around in the crevices of the world. Until the day it is called by its name.
en_grezzo: "Certain people realised the limits of their power, while others uttered the words in the hope that they would be active in the next life. Somehow it gained power and crawled around in the crevices of the world. Until the day it is called by its name."
it: C'è chi ha capito il limite della propria forza e chi ha pronunciato quella parola sperando in una vita futura piena di imprese. E quella parola, un giorno, ha ottenuto una forza sua e si è messa a strisciare per gli interstizi del mondo. Fino al momento in cui qualcuno la chiamerà per nome.

jp: 混沌の神が代行者として選んだ者。知識と力の一部、そして混沌の剣を分け与えられており、世界を混沌で包むために暗躍する。
jp_grezzo: "混沌の神が代行者として選んだ者。知識と力の一部、そして混沌の剣を分け与えられており、世界を混沌で包むために暗躍する。"
en: Chosen by the God of Chaos as his agent. He is given a portion of the knowledge and power, as well as the Sword of Chaos, and works in the dark to envelop the world in chaos.
en_grezzo: "Chosen by the God of Chaos as his agent. He is given a portion of the knowledge and power, as well as the Sword of Chaos, and works in the dark to envelop the world in chaos. "
it: Colui che il dio del caos ha scelto come proprio vicario. Gli ha ceduto una parte del sapere e della forza, e insieme la spada del caos, e lui trama nell'ombra per avvolgere il mondo nel caos.

jp: 世界の理を求め、それを支配しようと望む者。眼には狂気が宿っており、野放しにしておくのは危険と思われる。その科学力は魔法と区別がつかない。
jp_grezzo: "世界の理を求め、それを支配しようと望む者。眼には狂気が宿っており、野放しにしておくのは危険と思われる。その科学力は魔法と区別がつかない。"
en: One who seeks the truth of the world and wishes to control it. He has madness in his eyes and is considered dangerous to be left unchecked. His scientific powers are indistinguishable from magic.
en_grezzo: "One who seeks the truth of the world and wishes to control it. He has madness in his eyes and is considered dangerous to be left unchecked. His scientific powers are indistinguishable from magic."
it: Uno che cerca la legge che regge il mondo e vuole dominarla. Negli occhi gli abita la follia, e lasciarlo libero sembra pericoloso. La sua scienza non si distingue dalla magia.

jp: 天使としての仕事を一切せず自堕落な生活を送っていたため、力を剥奪され解雇された。しかし本人は気兼ねなく昼寝ができるようになったと喜んでいる。機能を失い飾りと化した翼が残っているが、外すのも面倒くさい模様。
jp_grezzo: "天使としての仕事を一切せず自堕落な生活を送っていたため、力を剥奪され解雇された。しかし本人は気兼ねなく昼寝ができるようになったと喜んでいる。機能を失い飾りと化した翼が残っているが、外すのも面倒くさい模様。"
en: She was stripped of her powers and dismissed from her job because she was living a self-defeating life without any work as an angel. However, she is happy that she can now take naps without any worries. She still has wings that have lost their function and have become decorations, but it appears that removing them is also a hassle.
en_grezzo: "She was stripped of her powers and dismissed from her job because she was living a self-defeating life without any work as an angel. However, she is happy that she can now take naps without any worries. She still has wings that have lost their function and have become decorations, but it appears that removing them is also a hassle."
it: Da angelo non lavorava per niente e conduceva una vita sregolata, così le hanno tolto i poteri e l'hanno licenziata. Lei però è contenta: adesso può schiacciare un pisolino senza pensieri. Le restano le ali, che hanno perso la loro funzione e sono diventate un ornamento, ma a quanto pare toglierle è una noia.

jp: 平民出でありながら実力でザナンの高官にまで登り詰めたが、大切な人を失ったことで地に墜ちた白き鷹。今は薬物に溺れ、その意識は虚ろに空を彷徨う。
jp_grezzo: "平民出でありながら実力でザナンの高官にまで登り詰めたが、大切な人を失ったことで地に墜ちた白き鷹。今は薬物に溺れ、その意識は虚ろに空を彷徨う。"
en: The White Hawk, a commoner who rose to a high position in Zanan Military with his abilities, but has fallen to the ground after losing someone he cared about. Now addicted to drugs, with his consciousness wandering aimlessly in the sky.
en_grezzo: "The White Hawk, a commoner who rose to a high position in Zanan Military with his abilities, but has fallen to the ground after losing someone he cared about. Now addicted to drugs, with his consciousness wandering aimlessly in the sky. "
it: Il falco bianco che, pur venendo dal popolo minuto, con le sue capacità era salito fino agli alti gradi di Zanan, e poi è caduto a terra per aver perso la persona a cui teneva. Adesso annega nella droga, e la sua coscienza vaga vuota per il cielo.

jp: ザナンでは英雄と称えられる、赤い長髪の有能な軍人。白き鷹に実力で勝ちたいと思っていたが、彼が勝手に脱落したので内心忸怩たる思いを抱えている。その強肩でも有名。
jp_grezzo: "ザナンでは英雄と称えられる、赤い長髪の有能な軍人。白き鷹に実力で勝ちたいと思っていたが、彼が勝手に脱落したので内心忸怩たる思いを抱えている。その強肩でも有名。"
en: A talented soldier with long red hair who is hailed as a hero of Zanan. He wanted to win against the White Hawk on his own merit, but they dropped out on their own accord, so he feels ashamed inside. He is also famous for his strong shoulders.
en_grezzo: "A talented soldier with long red hair who is hailed as a hero of Zanan. He wanted to win against the White Hawk on his own merit, but they dropped out on their own accord, so he feels ashamed inside. He is also famous for his strong shoulders."
it: Un militare capace, dai lunghi capelli rossi, che a Zanan celebrano come un eroe. Voleva battere il falco bianco sul campo, con le proprie forze, ma quello si è tirato fuori da solo, e dentro di sé se ne rode. È famoso anche per la potenza del suo braccio.

jp: 原初の神の炎より生まれた伝説の火炎竜の子孫。かつてドラゴンハンターが竜窟を襲撃した際、他の竜は全滅したのだがなぜか火炎竜は狙われもせず生き延びた。
jp_grezzo: "原初の神の炎より生まれた伝説の火炎竜の子孫。かつてドラゴンハンターが竜窟を襲撃した際、他の竜は全滅したのだがなぜか火炎竜は狙われもせず生き延びた。"
en: A descendant of the legendary flame dragon, born from the flames of a primordial god. When dragon hunters once attacked the Dragon Cave, all the other dragons were wiped out, but for some reason the flame dragon was not targeted and survived.
en_grezzo: "A descendant of the legendary flame dragon, born from the flames of a primordial god. When dragon hunters once attacked the Dragon Cave, all the other dragons were wiped out, but for some reason the flame dragon was not targeted and survived. "
it: Discendente del leggendario drago di fuoco, nato dalla fiamma del dio primordiale. Quando i cacciatori di draghi assalirono la Tana del Drago tutti gli altri draghi furono sterminati, ma il drago di fuoco, chissà perché, non fu nemmeno preso di mira e sopravvisse.

jp: ぬいぐるみが大好きな少女。集めるだけでは飽き足らず、ぬいぐるみ職人になるべく弟子入りをしたほど。しかし意外と不器用なところが災いし、いまだに見習いである。
jp_grezzo: "ぬいぐるみが大好きな少女。集めるだけでは飽き足らず、ぬいぐるみ職人になるべく弟子入りをしたほど。しかし意外と不器用なところが災いし、いまだに見習いである。"
en: A girl who loves stuffed toys. She is so bored with collecting them that she has taken up an apprenticeship to become a stuffed animal craftsman. However, she is surprisingly clumsy and is still an apprentice.
en_grezzo: "A girl who loves stuffed toys. She is so bored with collecting them that she has taken up an apprenticeship to become a stuffed animal craftsman. However, she is surprisingly clumsy and is still an apprentice."
it: Una ragazza che va matta per i pupazzi di pezza. Collezionarli non le bastava, e allora si è messa a bottega per diventare artigiana di pupazzi. Solo che, contro ogni previsione, ha le mani di pastafrolla, e apprendista è rimasta.

jp: ヴェルニースの酒場で働く娘。魅力的な尻は男女を問わず虜にするため、その下着をめぐり貴族達が血で血を洗う戦いをしていることを彼女は知らない。
jp_grezzo: "ヴェルニースの酒場で働く娘。魅力的な尻は男女を問わず虜にするため、その下着をめぐり貴族達が血で血を洗う戦いをしていることを彼女は知らない。"
en: A girl who works in a tavern in Vernis. Her irresistible buttocks are a magnet for men and women alike, and she is unaware of the bloodshed amongst the nobility over her panties.
en_grezzo: "A girl who works in a tavern in Vernis. Her irresistible buttocks are a magnet for men and women alike, and she is unaware of the bloodshed amongst the nobility over her panties. "
it: Una ragazza che lavora nella taverna di Vernis. Il suo fondoschiena incanta uomini e donne senza distinzione, e lei non sa che i nobili si stanno scannando per accaparrarsi la sua biancheria.

jp: 異世界から迷い込んできた猫族の戦士。シルヴィアを大事に思っているが、いかんせん遠征で留守にしている期間が長すぎた。
jp_grezzo: "異世界から迷い込んできた猫族の戦士。シルヴィアを大事に思っているが、いかんせん遠征で留守にしている期間が長すぎた。"
en: A warrior of the cat tribe who wandered in from another world. He cares for Sylvia, but has been away on expeditions for too long.
en_grezzo: "A warrior of the cat tribe who wandered in from another world. He cares for Sylvia, but has been away on expeditions for too long. "
it: Un guerriero del popolo dei gatti che si è smarrito qui da un altro mondo. A Silvia tiene molto, ma è stato via per le spedizioni per un tempo davvero troppo lungo.

jp: 異世界から飛ばされてきた皇女。不安定な時期に拉致監禁陵辱のフルコースをくらったため、相手にかつての思い人を重ねては情事を繰り返す色狂いと化してしまった。
jp_grezzo: "異世界から飛ばされてきた皇女。不安定な時期に拉致監禁陵辱のフルコースをくらったため、相手にかつての思い人を重ねては情事を繰り返す色狂いと化してしまった。"
en: She is an imperial princess who was cast out of another world. She was subjected to a full course of abduction, confinement and humiliation during a period of instability, and has turned into a sex-crazed woman who repeatedly has affairs with the people she once loved.
en_grezzo: "She is an imperial princess who was cast out of another world. She was subjected to a full course of abduction, confinement and humiliation during a period of instability, and has turned into a sex-crazed woman who repeatedly has affairs with the people she once loved. "
it: Una principessa imperiale sbalzata qui da un altro mondo. In un periodo fragile ha subito il trattamento completo, rapimento, prigionia e violenza, e da allora è diventata una donna smaniosa che in chi ha davanti rivede la persona amata di un tempo e ripete un amore dopo l'altro.

jp: 町やネフィアを清掃するために作られた人造生命体。吟遊詩人の残骸が気になる、という客の要望でヴェルニースの酒場にも1体配置されている。
jp_grezzo: "町やネフィアを清掃するために作られた人造生命体。吟遊詩人の残骸が気になる、という客の要望でヴェルニースの酒場にも1体配置されている。"
en: Artificial life forms created to clean up the town and Nefia. One is also placed in Vernis's tavern at the request of customers who are concerned about the remains of the bards.
en_grezzo: "Artificial life forms created to clean up the town and Nefia. One is also placed in Vernis's tavern at the request of customers who are concerned about the remains of the bards. "
it: Forme di vita artificiali costruite per ripulire le città e le Nefia. Su richiesta dei clienti, infastiditi dai resti dei menestrelli, ne hanno messo uno anche nella taverna di Vernis.

jp: 異形の森からやってきたエレアの民。彼女は『風を聴く者』と呼ばれているが、それは風から遠方の状況を感じとるその能力によるものである。
jp_grezzo: "異形の森からやってきたエレアの民。彼女は『風を聴く者』と呼ばれているが、それは風から遠方の状況を感じとるその能力によるものである。"
en: Elea folk who came from the Vindale Forest. She is known as 'the Listener of the Wind', due to her ability to sense distant conditions from the wind.
en_grezzo: "Elea folk who came from the Vindale Forest. She is known as 'the Listener of the Wind', due to her ability to sense distant conditions from the wind. "
it: Un'Elea venuta dalla Foresta Eretica. La chiamano l'ascoltatrice del vento, e il nome le viene dalla capacità di sentire dal vento che cosa accade lontano.

jp: 異形の森からやってきたエレアの民。当初は他にも使者がいたのだが、全員が謎の体調不良により動けなくなり、結果彼とラーネイレだけで出発することになった。
jp_grezzo: "異形の森からやってきたエレアの民。当初は他にも使者がいたのだが、全員が謎の体調不良により動けなくなり、結果彼とラーネイレだけで出発することになった。"
en: Elea folk who came from the Vindale Forest. Initially, there were other messengers, but they all became stuck due to mysterious illnesses, and as a result, only he and Larnneire were able to leave.
en_grezzo: "Elea folk who came from the Vindale Forest. Initially, there were other messengers, but they all became stuck due to mysterious illnesses, and as a result, only he and Larnneire were able to leave. "
it: Un Elea venuto dalla Foresta Eretica. All'inizio i messaggeri erano anche altri, ma si ammalarono tutti in modo misterioso e non poterono più muoversi: alla fine partirono soltanto lui e Larnneire.

jp: パルミア王家に仕える密偵。つかんだ情報を王に伝えるまでは死ぬわけにはいかない、とギリギリのところで踏ん張っている。任務が終わったら結婚する予定だった。
jp_grezzo: "パルミア王家に仕える密偵。つかんだ情報を王に伝えるまでは死ぬわけにはいかない、とギリギリのところで踏ん張っている。任務が終わったら結婚する予定だった。"
en: A secret agent in the service of the Palmia royal family. He is on the edge of his seat, determined not to die until he has passed on the information he has obtained to the king. He planned to get married when his mission was over.
en_grezzo: "A secret agent in the service of the Palmia royal family. He is on the edge of his seat, determined not to die until he has passed on the information he has obtained to the king. He planned to get married when his mission was over."
it: Una spia al servizio della casa reale di Palmia. Finché non avrà consegnato al re le informazioni che ha raccolto non può permettersi di morire, e resiste appeso a un filo. Quando la missione fosse finita, aveva in programma di sposarsi.

jp: レシマス調査に雇われた冒険者でカルーン出身。孤高で有能な実力者ゆえに孤狼の二つ名を持つ…と本人は思い込んでいたが実力はそこまで高くない。
jp_grezzo: "レシマス調査に雇われた冒険者でカルーン出身。孤高で有能な実力者ゆえに孤狼の二つ名を持つ…と本人は思い込んでいたが実力はそこまで高くない。"
en: He is an adventurer employed to investigate Lesimas and hails from Karune. He is a solitary, competent and capable person, hence his nickname of the Lone Wolf... although he believes he is not as competent as he thinks he is.
en_grezzo: "He is an adventurer employed to investigate Lesimas and hails from Karune. He is a solitary, competent and capable person, hence his nickname of the Lone Wolf... although he believes he is not as competent as he thinks he is. "
it: Un avventuriero originario di Karune, assunto per l'esplorazione di Lesimas. Solitario, capace, uno che vale davvero: per questo si porta il soprannome di lupo solitario... o almeno così si era convinto lui, perché tanto in gamba non è.
